title: Normalization of Samples for Genomic and Proteomic Applications
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare CSV input file
steps.instruction: Download the provided Excel template, edit it to list each sample's Slot number, Source well, Destination well, Start Concentration (µg/µL), Final Concentration (µg/mL), Sample volume (µL), Diluent volume (µL) and Total volume (µL) for every well, then save the file as a .csv. The column order must match the example: Sample number,Slot no number,Source well,Destination well,Start Concentration (ug/uL) Source,Final Concentration (ug/ml) Destination,Sample volume (uL),Diluent Volume(ul),Total Volume(ul) Destination. Example rows: 1,4,A1,A1,5,2,40,60,100.0 ; 2,4,C1,B1,3,2,67,33,100.0 ; 3,4,D1,C1,10,2,20,80,100.0 ; 4,4,E3,D1,20,2,10,90,100.0.

substeps.instruction: Download the Excel template from the provided link.
Enter the required data for each sample, preserving the column order.
Export the edited sheet to CSV format.

steps.title: Transfer diluent to destination wells
steps.instruction: Using a single pipette tip, aspirate the Diluent Volume (µL) specified for each destination well from the diluent reservoir and dispense it into the corresponding destination well of the end PCR plate. Continue this for all rows in the CSV without changing the tip, then discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: For each CSV row, aspirate the listed Diluent Volume (µL) from the diluent source.
Dispense the aspirated diluent into the Destination well.
Repeat until all destination wells have received their diluent.

steps.title: Transfer sample and mix
steps.instruction: For each sample row, pick up a new tip, aspirate the Sample volume (µL) from the Source well, dispense it into the Destination well that already contains the pre‑added diluent, mix the well by pipetting up and down three times, perform a blow‑out, touch the tip to the well wall, and then discard the tip. Repeat for every sample listed in the CSV.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the Sample volume (µL) from the Source well.
Dispense into the Destination well (which already contains diluent).
Mix the well 3× by aspirating and dispensing.
Touch the tip to the well wall.
